description:
## Problem
Tuning statements use the template's logical name with ad-hoc casing (`table_tuning.table_name.upper()` / `.lower()`), not the physical name the adapter's `create_schema` produced:
- **DuckDB:** `CREATE INDEX … ON LINEITEM (L_ORDERKEY…)` against quoted-lowercase tables makes DuckDB store the bound form `['(LINEITEM.L_ORDERKEY)']` and every index reports a false `mismatch`.
- **ClickHouse:** `OPTIMIZE TABLE LINEITEM FINAL` fails ("Table default.LINEITEM does not exist"); ClickHouse is case-sensitive.
- **BigQuery:** `apply_table_tunings` calls `get_table(dataset.table(table_tuning.table_name))` (`bigquery.py:2969-2972`) with the uppercase name, so the inspection fails on case-sensitive table names. A case-fallback helper already exists at `bigquery.py:1310-1319`.

## Change
- Add `PlatformAdapter.resolve_physical_table(logical_name) -> str` (and a column equivalent). It encodes each adapter's identifier policy: case folding, quoting, and schema or dataset qualification.
- DuckDB resolves through `duckdb_tables()` / `duckdb_columns()` case-insensitively.
- Replace casing hacks in the tuning builders of duckdb, clickhouse, snowflake, redshift, databricks, bigquery and synapse.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- No change to schema creation itself.
- The resolved name must equal the name `create_schema` created; this is tested per adapter.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
